input_encoding.count_source_description: raw/X (integer counts, same genes and order as var), checked per row
input_encoding.encoding: counts / row total * 1e4 / Geneformer gc104M gene median, ranked high->low, first max_len-2 genes, <bos>=2 ... <eos>=3 (maxtoki_adapter.tokenize_cell)
input_encoding.per_forward_check: tokenize_counts(check=True) + assert_encoding_batch on every 50-cell batch; 2000 cells in 40 batches passed; tokens equal prepare/cells_A.npz

outputs.acc_sums.npy: (11, 12, G_U, 1232) float32: slots 0-9 = sums over the cells of each random block, slot 10 = sums over Smart-seq2 cells only
outputs.acc_counts.npy: (11, G_U) cell counts per slot and gene
outputs.percell_sums.npy: (n, 12, 1232) per-cell sum over its panel-U positions (checksum)
outputs.layer_gene_embeddings_panelD.npy: (12, 1500, 1232) per-gene means over all cells, deployed layout
